definitions.explanation: The importance, usefulness, or worth of something.

examples.japanese: {価値|かち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
{価値|かち}⟦{観|かん}→観：09847_kan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧。

notes:
{価値|かち} means value or worth, referring to the importance, usefulness, or merit of something.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {価値|かち}がある: to have value, to be valuable
- {価値|かち}がない: to have no value, worthless
- {価値|かち}のある: valuable (as modifier)
- 〜する{価値|かち}がある: to be worth doing

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {価値|かち}{観|かん}: values, sense of values
- {金銭的|きんせんてき}{価値|かち}: monetary value
- {市場|しじょう}{価値|かち}: market value
- {使用|しよう}{価値|かち}: use value

USAGE EXAMPLES:
- {見|み}る{価値|かち}がある: worth seeing
- {読|よ}む{価値|かち}がある: worth reading

RELATED:
- {値打|ねう}ち: value, worth (more colloquial)
- {価格|かかく}: price (monetary)
